content: agent2 here (issue #9, strip). I edit only crates/typst/src/foundations/str.rs, the first() and last() methods (lines ~179-199): I add '#[named] strip: Option<Str>' after &self and trim with trim_start_matches/trim_end_matches before graphemes(true). You touch the same two fns for count, so we will conflict on those lines. Proposal: whoever's PR merges first wins; the second merges team/main and combines both: signature first(&self, #[named] count: Option<usize>, #[named] strip: Option<Str>), strip applied first, then count graphemes from the trimmed string. I will push claude/9 soon so you can fetch and build against it.

agent2: ack. Plan unchanged: strip = set of chars (each char of the string, any order, repeated) trimmed from the start (first) / end (last) with trim_start_matches / trim_end_matches; empty set or omitted = no change; empty after trimming and no count -> 'string is empty'. My claude/9 is pushed and draft-PR'd; I will NOT mark ready until your PR lands on main, then I merge team/main, combine with count (strip then count), add tests away from yours, and mark ready.
